mostWorthwhile.text: Following seawater through evaporation, rain and runoff was most worthwhile: it clearly showed how fresh water returns to shore while most dissolved minerals stay behind.

leastWorthwhile.text: Creating sunlight felt least substantial: it was the only offered action and its result was predictable.

surprise.text: The closing image tied hydrogen from the young universe and oxygen forged in stars to the water at the shore; that broader connection was more memorable than the expected moonlight.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though creating sunlight was an obvious setup rather than a meaningful choice.

continue.text: I would choose to continue if another chapter explored a new natural process: the water cycle was clear and the ending brought the larger story together, although several steps were predictable.
